_doc: Humanoid clips on the Quaternius UAL rig (bones root, pelvis, spine_01..03, neck_01, Head, clavicle/upperarm/lowerarm/hand_l|r, fingers, thigh/calf/foot/ball_l|r). One GLB per clip, one animation named as the clip id, 30 fps, frames from 0. Root bone is still; any travel is on the pelvis (root_motion_m is pelvis xy travel over the clip, metres, Blender axes Z-up, character faces -Y). Built by tools/anim_retarget (see README there). keys.combat binds animations.json / clip_map.json names, keys.interaction binds interactions.json ids; first clip is the preferred pick, picks are by name and need a look in a viewer.

mixamo.license: Mixamo terms: free in games and films
mixamo.note: Only inside the built game; not as standalone animation files or packs.

iglesias.note: Do not redistribute or resell the clips as a pack.
